source: reference/base/*.md — 15 board decodes (249 screens) + Evira PATTERN_LIBRARY.md / inv-01..04.md (162 entries, ~95 unique)
markerSyntax: plain = substring in any text file of appDir; 'app:' = app.js/index.html/styles.css only; 'data:' = data.js (the compiled layout+model — the discriminating file, because app.js embeds every runtime renderer whether or not the brief planned it); 're:' after a scope prefix = regex. See engine/reference/base_compliance.mjs header.
declarationSyntax: key:<briefKey> = planned if that top-level product-brief key is present/truthy; req:/regex/i = planned if any requirements[] sentence matches; items:<field> = planned if any collection.items[] entry carries a non-empty <field>; empty declarations = no brief key produces this screen in the current engine (only checkable when forced with --screens).
